mapper.insert: insert into collector (username, password, name, phone, id_card, id_card_front, id_card_back, work_status, rating, order_count, today_order_count, location_lat, location_lng, location_update_time, max_daily_orders, service_area, status, audit_status, reject_reason) values (#{username}, #{password}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{idCard}, #{idCardFront}, #{idCardBack}, #{workStatus}, #{rating}, #{orderCount}, #{todayOrderCount}, #{locationLat}, #{locationLng}, #{locationUpdateTime}, #{maxDailyOrders}, #{serviceArea}, #{status}, #{auditStatus}, #{rejectReason})
mapper.select: select * from collector where phone = #{phone} and id_card = #{idCard} order by create_time desc limit 1
select * from collector where id_card = #{idCard} limit 1

select *, (6371 * acos(cos(radians(#{lat})) * cos(radians(location_lat)) * cos(radians(location_lng) - radians(#{lng})) + sin(radians(#{lat})) * sin(radians(location_lat)))) as distance from collector where work_status = 1 and status = 1 and audit_status = 1 and location_lat is not null and location_lng is not null having distance <= #{radius} / 1000 order by distance limit 10
select * from collector where audit_status = 0 order by create_time desc
mapper.update: update collector set audit_status = 1, status = 1 where id = #{id}
update collector set audit_status = 2, reject_reason = #{reason} where id = #{id}
